  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-010000-delete.workspaces.time-off.policies-path-existence.json

    Path family confirmed live (GET /workspaces/{wId}/time-off/policies/{policyId} returns 200).

    Both PROGRESS.md rows (official {id} and ours {policyId}) covered by this probe.
    Raw allowlist: DELETE /workspaces/{workspaceId}/time-off/policies/{policyId} in line 142.
    Test policy MCP-LIVE-RECON-20260521-010000-A-policy-delete-test (<redacted-id:4b4f2c3686>)
    archived but not deleted — raw writes blocked. Cleanup: archived, left in workspace.
  x-truth-iter: iter17
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
    - name: policyId
      in: path
      required: true
      x-official-alias: id
  responses:
    '200':
      description: OK (expected, not live-confirmed)
endpoints.notes: Covers BOTH PROGRESS.md rows (official {id} alias and ours {policyId}). Same path position — functionally identical. Cannot live-verify DELETE without raw writes. Path family confirmed. Test policy <redacted-id:4b4f2c3686> archived (raw delete blocked).
